newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Corp Q2 earnings hurt by nuke rates.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Corp Q2 earnings hurt by nuke rates.

text.p: PG&E Corp Wednesday said its second quarter earnings were hurt by revisions to the ratemaking structure for its Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant.
Those changes, which took effect January 1, reduced second quarter earnings by nine cents a share, PG&E spokesman Greg Pruett said.
The new rate structure results in increased depreciation charges and a lower return on the Diablo Canyon plant, which is owned and operated by PG&E's utility subsidiary, Pacific Gas & Electric Co.
PG&E reported second quarter earnings of 49 cents a share, up from 25 cents in the second quarter 1996.

But those results included a one-time gain of 28 cents a share from the sale to Bechtel Corp of PG&E's interest in International Generating Co Ltd, an international developer of independent electric generation projects.
